entries.sense_en: money or property a bride's family gave to her husband when they married

synonyms.nuance: The clothes and linen a bride brings, not money; dowry is money or property.
Wealth received after someone dies, not at marriage.
Any large wealth; not tied to marriage.
synonyms.example: She married a man of fortune.

entries.tip_ko: 지금은 거의 쓰지 않는 옛 관습의 말입니다. 주인공이 '지참금도 없다'는 것은 좋은 혼처를 기대할 수 없다는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: a fixed social class that a person is born into

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; can change through money or education, unlike caste.
A position in a ladder of status, such as in the army or nobility.
Old-fashioned: one's place in society, often fixed by birth.

entries.tip_ko: 인도의 카스트 제도로 잘 알려진 단어입니다. 여기서는 '여자에게는 신분이 없고 미모와 매력이 신분을 대신한다'는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: natural cleverness and a quick, resourceful mind

synonyms.nuance: General quickness of mind; ingenuity is cleverness that invents or solves problems.
Making good use of whatever is available in a hard situation.
Making new things or ideas; not necessarily to solve a problem.

entries.tip_ko: ingenuity(재치)와 ingenuous(순진한)는 철자가 비슷하지만 뜻이 전혀 다릅니다.

entries.sense_en: old, worn and in poor condition

synonyms.nuance: Damaged by long use; says nothing about how it looks overall.
Untidy and unkempt; often used for people and clothes, and more informal.
Neglected and in bad repair; typical for buildings and neighborhoods.
Cloth worn so thin that the threads show.

entries.tip_ko: 사람의 행동에 쓰면 '치사한, 비열한'이라는 뜻도 됩니다 (a shabby trick).

entries.sense_en: a small room that leads into a larger, more important room

synonyms.nuance: Same meaning; a little more common in modern English.
The entrance hall of a hotel or public building; less grand.
Entrance hall of a theater or large building, also used for houses.

entries.tip_ko: ante-는 '앞'을 뜻하는 접두사입니다 (anteroom = 앞방).

entries.sense_en: a large decorative stand that holds several candles

synonyms.nuance: Hangs from the ceiling; a candelabra stands on a floor or table.
Holds just one candle.
A burning stick carried in the hand or fixed on a wall; rougher and less elegant.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 단수는 candelabrum이지만 현대 영어에서는 candelabra를 단수로도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: charming in a playful, flirting way (here, cozy and made to please)
entries.sense_ko: 교태 어린; (여기서는 방이) 아기자기하게 멋을 부린

synonyms.nuance: Clearly showing romantic interest in someone; coquettish is more playful and charming.
Fun and light, with no romantic hint.
Attractive in a way that draws you in; positive and less teasing.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '코케티시'에 가깝고 강세는 두 번째 음절 -quet-에 옵니다. 여기서는 방 분위기를 '아기자기하고 매력적인'으로 표현했습니다.

entries.sense_en: polite, flattering words and attentions that a man pays to a woman

synonyms.nuance: A single kind remark; gallantries are a whole style of courteous attention.
A code of honorable, protective behavior toward women; broader and more serious.
Praise that may be insincere and given to win favor.
synonyms.example: She was not fooled by his flattery.

entries.tip_ko: gallantry에는 '용감함'이라는 뜻도 있습니다 (gallantry in battle). 여기서는 여자에게 하는 예의 바른 아첨입니다.

entries.sense_en: calm and mysterious, giving nothing away

synonyms.nuance: Impossible to read or understand; the standard word for an unreadable face.
Mysterious and puzzling, often in an interesting way.
Showing no emotion on purpose, as in card games; informal.

entries.sense_en: a large deep covered dish for serving soup at the table

synonyms.nuance: General open dish for food; a tureen is bigger, has a lid and is for serving.
Used for cooking on the stove, not for serving at table.
Not a dish but the big spoon used to serve soup from a tureen.

entries.sense_en: proud and happy because of a success

synonyms.nuance: About actually winning a contest or war; triumphant is about the feeling of success.
Openly and noisily joyful, especially at good news; triumphant stresses pride in success.
Negative: too pleased with yourself in an annoying way.

entries.tip_ko: 명사 triumph /ˈtraɪəmf/는 첫 음절에, 형용사 triumphant는 두 번째 음절 -um-에 강세가 옵니다. ph는 /f/로 소리납니다.

entries.sense_en: limited to a small, privileged group of people; exclusive

synonyms.nuance: Closed to most people, often because of money or status; the usual modern word.
About the best or most powerful group; stronger than select.
Of high quality; about things, not about who is allowed in.

entries.tip_ko: select를 동사 '고르다'로만 알기 쉽지만, 형용사로는 '소수만 초대받는'이라는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: spoke with pauses and repeated sounds because of surprise or embarrassment

synonyms.nuance: Usually a speech habit or condition of repeating sounds; stammer is the British word and can be a moment of nerves.
synonyms.example: He stutters when he is tired.

synonyms.nuance: To lose strength or confidence in the voice, hesitating.
To speak quietly and unclearly; the problem is volume, not repetition.

entries.tip_ko: stammer와 stutter는 거의 같은 뜻이며, 영국에서는 stammer, 미국에서는 stutter를 더 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: supplied with what is needed (here, with good clothes)

synonyms.nuance: Given what is needed by someone else; less about being ready.
Ready for something, whether or not you have physical equipment.
synonyms.example: She was prepared for the test.

synonyms.nuance: Given all the gear or clothes needed for a particular purpose, such as a trip.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서는 '옷을 더 잘 갖춰 입을 수 있는'이라는 완곡한 표현입니다. be well equipped to do ~는 '~할 능력이 충분하다'는 뜻으로도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: saving money for a special purpose

synonyms.nuance: Almost identical; also used for time and rooms, not just money.
synonyms.example: I set aside an hour to read.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrase for collecting money over time for a goal.
synonyms.example: They saved up for a car.

synonyms.nuance: Informal; storing money or things for later.
synonyms.example: She puts away some money each month.

entries.sense_en: strange and different from usual

synonyms.nuance: Common everyday word for something unusual, with no strong feeling.
A bit more formal; unusual in a way that makes you curious or uneasy.
The most general word; may suggest something unfamiliar or slightly worrying.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 queer는 성소수자를 가리키는 말로 주로 쓰이므로, '이상한'이라는 옛 뜻으로 쓰면 오해를 살 수 있습니다. 대신 odd, strange를 쓰세요.

entries.sense_en: a piece of jewelry or decoration worn to look beautiful

synonyms.nuance: The general word for rings, necklaces and so on; ornament is broader and less common for wearing.
Anything that makes a place or thing look nicer, not just something worn.
Modern fashion word for bags, scarves, belts and the like.

entries.tip_ko: 명사는 /ˈɔrnəmənt/, 동사 '꾸미다'는 /ˈɔrnəˌmɛnt/로 발음합니다.

entries.sense_en: making you feel ashamed and lower in other people's eyes

synonyms.nuance: Milder: makes you feel awkward, not necessarily worthless.
Stronger: takes away your dignity or self-respect.
Very intense shame, so strong you want to disappear.

entries.tip_ko: humiliate(굴욕감을 주다)의 -ing형은 상황을 설명하고, humiliated는 그 상황에서 느끼는 사람의 감정을 설명합니다.

entries.sense_en: a tall cupboard for keeping clothes

synonyms.nuance: American word; often a built-in space in the wall rather than a piece of furniture.
Any cabinet with doors, for dishes or other things too.
A large, often ornate freestanding wardrobe; more elegant and French.

entries.tip_ko: wardrobe는 '옷장'이라는 가구뿐 아니라 '(한 사람이 가진) 옷 전체'(summer wardrobe)도 뜻합니다.

entries.sense_en: the skill and quality with which something is made by hand

synonyms.nuance: Stresses high, artistic skill; workmanship can be good or poor.
The skill or trade itself, not the quality of the result.
General measure of how good something is; not about who made it.

entries.tip_ko: of admirable workmanship은 '훌륭하게 세공된'이라는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: to decide after thinking; here, to decide to give the jewels back

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday verb; the idiom stresses the effort of choosing between options.
synonyms.example: I can't decide what to wear.

synonyms.nuance: More formal, usually after careful thought or discussion.
synonyms.example: The board came to a decision.

synonyms.nuance: Feeling pulled in two directions and unable to choose.

entries.tip_ko: make up one's mind는 결정을 내리는 행동을, be undecided는 정하지 못한 상태를 나타냅니다.

entries.sense_en: going too far; not controlled or reasonable

synonyms.nuance: The common word for too much of something.
Spending or wanting far more than is sensible, especially money.
Without any control or limit, often about emotions or behavior.

entries.tip_ko: in- 접두사 + moderate(적당한)로 이루어져 '적당하지 않은'이라는 뜻입니다. 문어체입니다.

entries.sense_en: a state of overwhelming happiness where you forget everything else

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general happiness; ecstasy is far more intense.
Calm, complete happiness; ecstasy is more excited and overwhelming.
Lighter pleasure, often in something specific.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 Ecstasy는 마약 이름으로도 쓰입니다. 강세는 첫 음절에 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: extreme delight that seems to lift you out of yourself

synonyms.nuance: Weaker, warm pleasure; rapture is total absorption.
Happy excitement after good news or success.
Very close; can suggest losing self-control even more.

entries.tip_ko: in rapture / go into raptures about ~ 형태로 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: public admiration and respect shown to a person

synonyms.nuance: A gift, speech or act that honors someone, often after achievement or death.
synonyms.example: a tribute to the late singer

synonyms.nuance: The feeling itself, not the outward show of it.
synonyms.example: She looked at him with admiration.

synonyms.nuance: Praise that is exaggerated or insincere.

entries.tip_ko: pay homage to ~는 '~에 경의를 표하다'라는 뜻의 자주 쓰는 표현입니다. h는 발음되지 않는 경우도 있지만 보통 /ˈhɑmɪdʒ/입니다.

entries.sense_en: to become ill with a cold from being chilled

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern form with the article.
synonyms.example: Wear a coat or you'll catch a cold.

synonyms.nuance: Informal; used for any illness starting to take hold.
synonyms.example: She came down with the flu.

synonyms.nuance: General; any illness, not only a cold.
synonyms.example: Don't get sick before the trip.

entries.tip_ko: 관사 없는 catch cold도 아직 쓰지만 다소 예스러운 표현이고, 오늘날에는 catch a cold가 더 흔합니다.

entries.sense_en: a shawl or coat worn over the shoulders to keep warm

synonyms.nuance: A wide piece of cloth worn over the shoulders; a wrap is any such covering.
A long, loose outer coat without sleeves, more old-fashioned.
A long, elegant scarf of fur or silk worn over the shoulders for evening dress.

entries.tip_ko: wrap은 '싸다'라는 동사로만 알기 쉽지만, 여기서는 걸치는 옷을 뜻하는 명사입니다.

entries.sense_en: a stone landing or embankment along a river or harbor (here, the street along the Seine in Paris)

synonyms.nuance: A structure built out from the shore for ships; quay runs along the shore.
A platform sticking out into the water, also used for walking or fishing.
The water area where ships are kept, or the whole loading area.

entries.tip_ko: 철자와 달리 /ki/(키)로 발음합니다. key와 발음이 같습니다.

entries.sense_en: a set of rooms on one floor of a building where someone lives

synonyms.nuance: The American word for the same thing.
A whole separate building, usually with its own door to the street.
Rooms rented in someone's home or a cheap building, temporary and simple.

entries.tip_ko: 영국 영어의 flat = 미국 영어의 apartment입니다.

entries.sense_en: a small entrance hall just inside the front door

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for an entrance space in a house.
synonyms.example: Leave your coat in the hall.

synonyms.nuance: A lobby of a theater or a fancy building; slightly more modern.
Public entrance area in hotels and offices.

entries.sense_en: so shocked that you cannot speak or move

synonyms.nuance: Very surprised, but you can still react normally.
synonyms.example: I was astonished by the news.

synonyms.nuance: Too surprised to say anything; very close in meaning.
Shocked, as if hit; can be from bad or good news.
synonyms.example: She was stunned by the result.

entries.tip_ko: thunder(천둥) + struck(맞은)라는 그림 그대로의 단어라 외우기 쉽습니다.

entries.sense_en: a sudden, serious misfortune that causes great loss or distress

synonyms.nuance: The common word; can be large-scale or personal.
Even bigger and more final; complete ruin.
Milder: bad luck, not necessarily a huge event.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절 -lam-에 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: a small metal fastener that holds a necklace or bag closed

synonyms.nuance: General word for anything that holds things together, like a zipper or a button.
A frame with a pin, used for belts and shoes.
A simple small device that keeps a lid or door shut.

entries.tip_ko: 동사로는 '꽉 잡다, 움켜쥐다'(clasp her hands)입니다. 발음할 때 l을 확실히 하세요.

entries.sense_en: to have a short period to get organized and deal with a problem
entries.sense_ko: 숨 돌릴 여유를 얻다, 수습할 시간을 벌다

synonyms.nuance: Deliberately gaining more time by delaying something.
synonyms.example: He tried to buy time with excuses.

synonyms.nuance: To understand a new or confusing situation before acting.
synonyms.example: We need a day to get our bearings.

synonyms.nuance: To rest briefly during something tiring or busy.

entries.tip_ko: 글자 그대로는 '몸을 돌리다'지만, 여기서는 '여유를 갖고 방법을 찾을 시간'이라는 관용적 표현입니다.

entries.sense_en: an unhappy, annoyed feeling because of failure or a mistake

synonyms.nuance: Mild irritation about anything; chagrin comes from your own failure or disappointment.
Sadness that something did not happen as hoped; less sharp.
Stronger and more embarrassed, like deep shame.

entries.tip_ko: 프랑스어에서 온 말이라 ch는 /ʃ/(쉬)로 발음합니다. to one's chagrin(~가 분하게도) 형태로 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: people who lend money and charge very high interest

synonyms.nuance: Neutral: anyone who lends money for interest; usurer implies unfair, very high rates.
Modern informal term for an illegal lender who threatens borrowers.
Works for a legal institution; not exploitative by definition.

entries.tip_ko: usury(고리대금), usurious(고리의)와 함께 외워 두면 좋습니다. 발음은 /ˈjuʒ-/입니다.

entries.sense_en: the lack of basic things like food, warmth and comfort

synonyms.nuance: Difficult conditions in general, not only lack of things.
Being kept from something you need; more formal and often social or medical.
The state of having very little money.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 복수형(privations)으로 쓰여 '궁핍한 생활의 여러 고통'을 뜻합니다.

entries.sense_en: a small, cheap room directly under the roof

synonyms.nuance: Usual word; often used for storage, not for living in.
Modern: an open upper space, often fashionable to live in.
The opposite: a luxury apartment on the top floor.

entries.tip_ko: 가난한 예술가의 다락방을 떠올리게 하는 문학적 단어입니다.

entries.sense_en: dirty water and household waste, carried out of the house to be thrown away

synonyms.nuance: Water used for washing dishes; only one kind of slops.
Modern neutral word for used water of any kind.
Waste carried in sewers, including toilet waste; much more unpleasant.

entries.tip_ko: slop은 동사로 '(액체를) 흘리다'라는 뜻이기도 합니다.

entries.sense_en: rude, disrespectful behavior or remarks

synonyms.nuance: The general word for bad manners toward anyone.
synonyms.example: I was shocked by his rudeness.

synonyms.nuance: Openly disrespectful toward someone with authority; stronger.
British informal for daring rudeness, often mild or half-joking.

entries.tip_ko: impertinent(건방진)의 명사형입니다. pertinent(적절한)에 im-이 붙은 모양이지만 '부적절한'보다 '건방진, 무례한'이라는 뜻으로 주로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: a small old French coin; sou by sou means one tiny coin at a time
entries.sense_ko: 수 (옛 프랑스의 작은 동전); sou by sou는 '한 푼 한 푼'

synonyms.nuance: The nearest English coin for something tiny; used in phrases like 'penny by penny'.
The American small coin, worth a hundredth of a dollar.
An old British coin worth very little, used in old sayings.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '수'에 가깝습니다. 이 소설에서는 화폐 franc, sou, louis가 등장합니다.

entries.sense_en: untidy and dirty-looking, as if not cared for

synonyms.nuance: Messy and not combed or cared for; the usual word for hair and beards.
Informal: shabby and untidy in a rough way.
Dull and unfashionable, especially of a woman; not necessarily dirty.

entries.tip_ko: frowzy라고도 씁니다. 매우 문어적이고 드문 단어입니다.

entries.sense_en: not straight; twisted or tilted to one side

synonyms.nuance: Bent or not straight in shape; can also mean dishonest.
Uneven because one side is bigger or heavier.
Literary: off the right course; also used for plans that go wrong.

entries.tip_ko: hang askew, go askew처럼 서술적으로 씁니다. 여기서는 치마가 한쪽으로 비뚤어지게 돌아간 모습입니다.

entries.sense_en: innocent and open, trusting others without suspicion

synonyms.nuance: Lacking experience in a way that may look foolish; ingenuous is gentler and more charming.
Honest and direct in what you say.
Natural and simple, with no wish to impress or trick.

entries.tip_ko: ingenious(기발한), ingenuity(재치)와 철자가 비슷하지만 뜻이 다릅니다. ingenuous = 순진한.

entries.sense_en: artificial glass made to look like diamonds or other gems

synonyms.nuance: Any copy of something more valuable; paste is specifically fake gems.
A shiny glass stone used in cheap costume jewelry.
Blunt and general, often suggesting the aim to deceive.

entries.tip_ko: paste는 '풀, 반죽'이 일반적인 뜻이지만, 여기서는 가짜 보석용 유리를 뜻하는 옛 용법입니다. 이 반전이 소설의 결말입니다.
